units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 1:2:7">Y. Sot. I, 16ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>כדי ג׳ ביצה</he> as much time as is required for roasting an egg in the ashes; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9:10">Num. R. s. 9</cite>.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 3:3:2">Y. Pes. III, 30ᵃ</cite> <he>לאחר גִּילְגּוּלָהּ</he> after the dough has been rolled (formed).—
<cite ref="Ketubot 111a:21">Keth. 111ᵃ</cite> <he>ע״י ג׳</he> by rolling under the ground (for resurrection in the Holy Land).

senses.gloss: (with or without שבועה) the rule permitting the court to insert in an oath an affirmation to which the person concerned could not have been compelled directly; an oath by implication.
units: Yeb. 58ᵇ; Kidd. l. c. ע״י ג׳ by implication (the woman including in her oath the time of her betrothal); a. fr.—4) (cmp. גַּל) בית ג׳ a field full of hills and depressions.
